title: Business Studies
description: ISC Class XI Business Studies: business organisation and management fundamentals.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Business Studies (subject code 859) (www.cisce.org).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026 against the CISCE-copyrighted ISC Year 2027 Business Studies (859) syllabus document with a CLASS XI section, read through its AglaSem reproduction because cisce.org returns 403 to automated fetches, with a Scribd copy as corroboration. Class XI prescribes Paper I Theory (3 hours, 80 marks) and Paper II Project Work (20 marks, two projects of 10 marks each) across four units, all four registered below.

sections.title: Business Studies
sections.description: Four theory units from the business environment to automation, plus project work.

chapters.title: Business Environment
chapters.blurb: The meaning of the business environment, its features and importance, general and specific forces and stakeholders, PESTLE analysis and Porter's five-factor analysis, and SWOT analysis.

chapters.title: Entrepreneurship
chapters.blurb: The entrepreneur and entrepreneurship, Danhof's types, intrapreneurship, setting up an enterprise, the five business phases, and business risks with their causes of failure and management methods.

chapters.title: Managers and Managerial Roles
chapters.blurb: Mintzberg's informational, interpersonal and decisional roles, authority, responsibility and accountability, delegation and decentralisation, and change management with the Lewin and ADKAR models.

chapters.title: Automation at Workplaces
chapters.blurb: Mechanisation and automation: their meaning, evolution, merits and demerits, and the productivity tools used in banks, the retail industry, corporate offices and airports.
